description:
Join my community & get free value. Take this short survey (takes 1 minute):  https://tally.so/r/RGXj5Q

I'll be offering a free 20-minute call for people who fill in the survey. 

Remotion + Claude Code built this Vox-style motion graphics explainer. Fully 
narrated, broadcast quality, no After Effects and no timeline.

🎁 Free Skool community and asset pack:
https://www.skool.com/ai-visual-production-lab-4976?utm_campaign=v1

I didn't edit a single frame. Every animated cut-out, every chart that draws 
itself, every cut that lands right on the word, all of it is code that Claude 
Code wrote from plain prompts. This Remotion tutorial walks through the exact 
workflow start to finish so you can do it yourself.

🛠️ Tools used:
Remotion (make videos with React and code): https://remotion.dev
Claude Code: https://claude.com/claude-code

⏱️ Chapters
0:00 The finished Vox-style explainer
1:30 Planning the script and visual style
2:26 Building the motion graphics scenes with Claude Code and Remotion
8:00 Assembling and fine-tuning the edit
11:01 Voiceover, music and final render

🔔 If this made AI feel a little more easy, hit subscribe — that's the whole point of this channel.

#Remotion #ClaudeCode #AIVideo #MotionGraphics #VideoEditing #AImadeeasy
